mentions.name: minfx
mentions.description: This is a machine learning experiment tracking platform positioned as a much more powerful and faster replacement for Neptune and Wandb (Weights & Biases), with Web + Native clients and a planned offline local version.
mentions.problem: Existing ML experiment tracking tools like Neptune and Wandb are not powerful or fast enough.
mentions.audience: If you work in machine learning
